name: Pool-share migration demand
hypothesis: Buy a confirmed trend when pool market share migrates to a cheaper executable route and aggregate net demand rises.
spec: Setup: Trading may shift toward a cheaper pool while total external demand expands. Entry: Buy a confirmed trend when pool market share migrates to a cheaper executable route and aggregate net demand rises. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if aggregate demand reverses or route quality deteriorates. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs synchronized multi-pool DEX quotes (not connected)
